chapters.title: The Word became flesh
chapters.summary: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was God. The light shines in the darkness, and the Word became flesh and dwelt among us. John the Baptist points to the Lamb of God, and the first disciples follow.

chapters.title: Water into wine
chapters.summary: At a wedding in Cana, Jesus turns water into wine, the first of His signs. In Jerusalem He drives out the money changers and speaks of His body as the temple.

chapters.title: Born again
chapters.summary: Nicodemus comes to Jesus by night and learns he must be born again of water and the Spirit. For God so loved the world, that He gave His only begotten Son.

chapters.title: The woman at the well
chapters.summary: Jesus asks a Samaritan woman for water and offers her living water. She tells her town about Him, and many believe. He heals an official's son.

chapters.title: The healing at Bethesda
chapters.summary: Jesus heals a man who had been ill for thirty-eight years, on the Sabbath. He says He does what He sees the Father doing, and the Scriptures testify of Him.

chapters.title: The bread of life
chapters.summary: Jesus feeds five thousand and walks on the sea, then says, I am the bread of life. Many leave Him, but Peter says: Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.

chapters.title: Rivers of living water
chapters.summary: At the Feast of Tabernacles opinions divide over Jesus. He cries out: if anyone thirsts, let him come to me and drink, and rivers of living water will flow.

chapters.title: The light of the world
chapters.summary: Jesus refuses to condemn a woman caught in adultery: go and sin no more. He says, I am the light of the world, and the truth shall make you free. Before Abraham was, I am.

chapters.title: The man born blind
chapters.summary: Jesus heals a man born blind. The Pharisees question him and throw him out, and he says, once I was blind, now I see. He worships Jesus.

chapters.title: The good shepherd
chapters.summary: I am the good shepherd; the good shepherd gives His life for the sheep. My sheep hear my voice and no one can snatch them out of my hand. I and the Father are one.

chapters.title: Lazarus raised
chapters.summary: Lazarus dies, and Jesus comes to Bethany. I am the resurrection and the life. Jesus weeps, then calls Lazarus out of the tomb. The leaders plot His death.

chapters.title: The hour has come
chapters.summary: Mary anoints Jesus' feet. He enters Jerusalem as king. A grain of wheat must die to bear fruit, and when He is lifted up He will draw all people to Himself.

chapters.title: Jesus washes their feet
chapters.summary: At supper Jesus washes His disciples' feet and tells them to do the same. He foretells Judas' betrayal and gives a new commandment: love one another as I have loved you.

chapters.title: The way, the truth and the life
chapters.summary: Let not your heart be troubled. In my Father's house are many rooms. I am the way, the truth and the life. Jesus promises the Comforter and leaves His peace.

chapters.title: The true vine
chapters.summary: I am the vine, you are the branches; abide in me and you will bear much fruit. Greater love has no one than this, to lay down one's life for friends.

chapters.title: Sorrow turned to joy
chapters.summary: The Spirit will guide the disciples into all truth. Their sorrow will turn to joy. In the world you will have trouble, but take heart, I have overcome the world.

chapters.title: Jesus prays for His followers
chapters.summary: Jesus prays to the Father for His glory, for His disciples to be kept and made holy, and for all who will believe, that they may be one.

chapters.title: Arrest and trial
chapters.summary: Jesus is arrested in a garden. Peter denies Him three times. Before Pilate Jesus says His kingdom is not of this world. Pilate asks, What is truth?

chapters.title: It is finished
chapters.summary: Pilate hands Jesus over to be crucified. From the cross Jesus entrusts His mother to the beloved disciple, says "It is finished," and dies. He is buried in a new tomb.

chapters.title: The empty tomb
chapters.summary: Mary Magdalene finds the tomb empty, and the risen Jesus calls her by name. He appears to the disciples and breathes the Spirit on them. Thomas believes: my Lord and my God.

chapters.title: Do you love me?
chapters.summary: Jesus appears by the Sea of Galilee and gives a great catch of fish. Three times He asks Peter, do you love me? and tells him, feed my sheep. Follow me.
